request: After the guide and visa icons became Galleria cartouches (#239), the owner sent a phone screenshot of the visa page with the burgundy notebook in its header: «Надо было заменить вот это блокнот, он как раз так и проблематичен». The topic pictures of guides and visa — the header of each guide, the catalogue tiles, the guide and visa roads and the visa point switcher — move to the same chosen style (round five, variant 7). The home page, the cabinet and the plan keep the shared object set (design/illustrations/objects-2026-11-13.json). Then, on why the first take differed from the approved variants («Почему это отличается от вариантов которые ты делал до этого и которые я одобрил»), the set was redone from the original variant 7 images, and on the small cartouches in the overview cells: «Убери эти мелкие гербы, они тут ни к чему, везде применяй этот принцип» — the picture is only large: the topic header, the catalogue tile, the visa point switcher. The road thumbs (56 px) keep the shared objects. On 19 Nov, on the catalogue tiles: the visa gets «флаг конкретный Казахстана» (kz-flag; the passport cartouche stays with the visa point about the passport), the DSU coins looked «слишком по-яичному» and became refined thin coins, the family documents lost the two odd columns for a family tree on papers; the document-check upload zone swapped its felt folder («чуть страшновата») for the doc-check cartouche. Then: «отчекань на монетах самого Веспи», «на визу D изобрази именно что паспорт Казахстана», «справки о семье переработай» — Vespi on the coin, the Kazakhstan passport for the visa topic and its passport point, a family cameo over a sealed certificate. Then, on the permesso tile: «сделай иконку пластиковой карточки пермессо с фоткой Веспи» (permesso-card; the crossed keys stay with the visa points about housing), and on the home scene «После визы путь продолжается»: «замени иконки… тоже» — its three cards (permesso, codice fiscale, insurance) show these cartouches. Then, on the home route stage cards: «почему здесь остались старые иконки» — Маршрут route-map, До отъезда suitcase, В Италии keys.

template: In the same style as the reference images, but do not copy their outline: draw a new Baroque strapwork cartouche of its own. In the style of the floor of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan, polished marble tesserae, freshly laid, seen straight from above: a Baroque strapwork cartouche with a cream ivory ground laid in rows, its edges curling outward into rich slate-blue scrolled straps with ochre and terracotta inner bands, acanthus leaves in leaf green, crowned at the top by a terracotta and ochre scallop shell; no square, no circle. In the centre a flat symmetrical emblem laid in the same small tesserae as everything else, matte, no bevel, no gloss, no drop shadow, classical in form like the reference coins, hourglass and temple: {motif}. Palette: cream ivory, warm ochre, terracotta red, slate blue, leaf green. Flat, not a 3D object, not an emoji, not an app pictogram. Transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers.
processing: crop to alpha (>4 %), centred on a transparent square plus 6 px; master WebP q92 in design/illustrations/source/cartouche/; site WebP q76 (method 6) at 240 and 480 px named <name>.<first 8 hex of the master SHA-256>-<size>.webp, mapped in src/components/guides/cartoucheFiles.ts and cached for a year (netlify.toml). q86 → q76 and the hashed names: 19 Nov, on slow icons on phones; the set went from 2.3 MB to 1.6 MB.

frames.C: acanthus cartouche: slate-blue and cream acanthus scrolls around a plain ochre ground, upright acanthus finial on top, terracotta and cream garland swag below (exemplar 71f063a7)
frames.D: terracotta shield with a cream field, cream and slate-blue volutes and an ochre fleur-de-lis on top, acanthus folding out below (exemplar 21354dc2)
frames.E: pointed quatrefoil, deep slate-blue ground, cream band and ochre line, terracotta lilies at the four tips, a ring of cream dots (exemplar 17b9cf02)

frames_2026_11_19.prompt: Two image references: the icon's earlier cartouche («take only the object in its very centre… leave out everything around it: no scallop shell, no slate-blue scrolled straps, no acanthus leaves») and the frame exemplar («take the frame exactly, but not the object in its centre»). A first pass with only the earlier cartouche as reference carried its shell and inner scrolls into every new frame.
